The match was played on 6 April 2024 at [[Estadio de La Cartuja]] in [[Seville]] between [[Athletic Bilbao]] and [[RCD Mallorca|Mallorca]].{{cite news |title=LaLiga 2023-24 fixtures: opening weekend, El Clásico... |url=https://en.as.com/soccer/laliga-2023-24-fixtures-opening-weekend-el-clasico-n/ |website=[[Diario AS]] |date=22 June 2023}} Mallorca played in their first final since their only victory in [[2003 Copa del Rey final|2003]], having lost twice prior.{{cite news |last1=Azzoni |first1=Tales |title=Mallorca beats Real Sociedad on penalties to return to Copa del Rey final two decades later |url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/soccer/2024/02/27/mallorca-beats-real-sociedad-on-penalties-to-return-to-copa-del-rey-final-two-decades-later/72765135007/ |work=[[USA Today]] |date=27 February 2024}} This was Athletic Bilbao's 40th final,{{Efn|group=note|name=count|Athletic Club's own records also include a win in the [[1902 Copa de la Coronación final]] and a defeat in the [[1907 Copa del Rey final]] in which the participating team was [[Bizcaya (football team)|Club Vizcaya]], a combination of players from Athletic and other local teams ([[Bilbao Football Club]] and Unión Vizcaino, respectively).}} having last appeared in the final in [[2021 Copa del Rey final|2021]], and its last victory was in [[1984 Copa del Rey final|1984]].{{cite news |last1=Azzoni |first1=Tales |title=Athletic Bilbao ends Atletico Madrid's 28-match unbeaten streak at home in 1st leg of Copa semifinal
